answer: An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 4 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. Because the crystal count is verified against the grove text itself, the comet audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. Filling 178 aliases thus means producing 178 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. That is 19 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
